structure.body_paragraf_1: First argument with evidence and analysis
structure.body_paragraf_2: Second argument with evidence and analysis

structure.introduction: Setting the scene and introducing the subject

structure.rising_action: Development of the story and tension

structure.body_paragraf_3: Third main point with examples (if needed)

excellent.description: Insightful, well-developed ideas with strong supporting evidence and examples

good.description: Clear ideas with adequate development and supporting details

satisfactory.description: Basic ideas with some development but limited supporting evidence

needs_improvement.description: Unclear or underdeveloped ideas with minimal supporting evidence

excellent.description: Logical flow with clear topic sentences, smooth transitions, and effective paragraphing

good.description: Generally logical organization with adequate transitions

satisfactory.description: Basic organization but some unclear connections between ideas

needs_improvement.description: Lacks clear organization with weak or missing transitions

excellent.description: Sophisticated vocabulary, varied sentence structure, and engaging writing style

good.description: Appropriate vocabulary with some variety in sentence structure

satisfactory.description: Basic vocabulary and simple sentence structure

needs_improvement.description: Limited vocabulary with repetitive or awkward sentence structure

excellent.description: Few or no grammatical errors, proper punctuation, and correct spelling

good.description: Minor errors that don't interfere with meaning

needs_improvement.description: Frequent errors that interfere with understanding

exercises.title: Keeping Fit / Healthy Lifestyle
exercises.prompt: Write an essay about keeping fit and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Discuss effective ways to stay fit and examine the harmful effects of unhealthy eating habits.
writing_tips: Use specific examples to support your points
Compare healthy vs unhealthy habits
Include a conclusion that summarizes your main arguments

exercises.title: Vegetarian Lifestyle
exercises.prompt: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of following a vegetarian lifestyle. Support your arguments with specific examples.
writing_tips: Present both sides fairly
Use specific nutritional examples
Mention the importance of professional guidance

exercises.title: The Importance of Respect
exercises.prompt: Explain the importance of respect in our daily lives and how we can show respect to others in different situations.
key_points: Different contexts where respect is needed
Impact on personal and social development
writing_tips: Give concrete examples from different life situations
Explain both giving and receiving respect
Connect respect to broader social harmony

exercises.title: Family Gatherings in Modern Society
exercises.prompt: In an era of digital communication and busy schedules, discuss why face-to-face family meetings remain crucial for maintaining strong familial bonds.
writing_tips: Connect to modern technology context
Use specific cultural examples
Emphasize the irreplaceable nature of face-to-face interaction

exercises.title: Environmental Challenges in Kuwait
exercises.prompt: Describe the major environmental challenges facing Kuwait today and discuss their impact on the country's future.
key_points: Air pollution from industrial and vehicle emissions
writing_tips: Use specific examples of environmental problems
Connect challenges to economic and social impacts
Propose realistic solutions

exercises.title: Kuwait's Water Management: A Critical Analysis
exercises.prompt: Evaluate Kuwait's current water management strategy and propose improvements for ensuring long-term water security.
writing_tips: Provide specific technical details and statistics
Present concrete, implementable solutions
Balance criticism with constructive proposals

exercises.title: A Day as an Endangered Houbara Bustard
exercises.prompt: Write a narrative story from the perspective of an endangered Houbara Bustard, describing its daily struggles and the challenges it faces due to human activity.
writing_tips: Use first-person narrative voice
Include sensory details and emotional responses
Connect individual story to broader conservation message
